<thought>From the 13C NMR spectrum, the distinct chemical shift values are 167.15, 143.85, 130.30, 34.53, 22.80, 21.35, and 19.20 ppm. The shift 34.53 appears twice, indicating two carbons share the same environment. Thus there are 7 unique carbon environments.</thought>
<final_answer>7</final_answer>
